**Reference / status:** Shire/Clydesdale/Percheron-inspired.

**Visual build:** Very tall, broad, deep barrel and massive hindquarters; thick neck, large hooves, optional feathered fetlocks.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Measured, steady, powerful visual impression; slow-looking but capable of substantial effort.

**Avoid:** Do not make every heavy horse feather-legged; feathering varies.

**Reference / status:** Ardennes/Suffolk Punch-inspired.

**Visual build:** Shorter, exceptionally deep and rounded, broad forehead, powerful shoulders, comparatively short legs.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Solid, dependable and grounded silhouette.

**Avoid:** Not a pony; adult mass and bone remain considerable.

**Reference / status:** Thoroughbred-inspired.

**Visual build:** Tall, long-legged, narrow waist, deep chest, lean muscle, long sloping shoulder and fine head.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Alert, reactive, long-striding presentation.

**Avoid:** Avoid making the body skeletal or fragile.

**Reference / status:** Arabian/Barb-inspired.

**Visual build:** Moderate height, compact athletic torso, dry legs, refined head, high-carried tail or distinctive profile.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Attentive, economical movement; persistent pacing.

**Avoid:** Distinct from sprint racer by compact frame, not fantasy speed effects.

**Reference / status:** Standardbred/Hackney-inspired.

**Visual build:** Balanced medium build, strong hindquarters, defined joints, substantial neck and high-stepping or efficient trotting gait.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Disciplined pair-work and controlled carriage movement.

**Avoid:** Not automatically a warhorse or ceremonial animal.

**Reference / status:** Icelandic/Fell pony-inspired.

**Visual build:** Short, thick-coated, broad-footed, muscular, low center of gravity, dense mane and tail.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Sure-footed and hardy appearance.

**Avoid:** Clearly mature pony, not a foal.

**Reference / status:** Akhal-Teke/Arabian-inspired.

**Visual build:** Long dry limbs, lean narrow torso, fine coat, refined face and sparse feathering.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Heat-adapted silhouette and light, economical movement.

**Avoid:** Metallic sheen is optional natural coat effect, not magic.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); dense winter mane and thick lower-leg coat.

**Visual build:** Very broad chest, shaggy neck, powerful forequarters, heavy antlers.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Imposing cold-country working appearance.

**Avoid:** Do not conceal legs in fur.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); selected manageable antler spread.

**Visual build:** Leaner legs, tighter coat, compact crown and lighter front end.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Fast, controlled silhouette for paired harness.

**Avoid:** Keep recognizable elk antlers.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); woodland edge adaptation.

**Visual build:** Moderate frame, dark dappled coat, comparatively narrow antlers.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Agile and alert presentation.

**Avoid:** Do not add supernatural forest glow.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); display-oriented line.

**Visual build:** Deep chest, towering branching antlers, luxuriant mane.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Regal spectacle; less practical-looking harness profile.

**Avoid:** Do not imply every grandcrown is a race entrant.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); traditional heavy hauling line.

**Visual build:** Huge shoulders, thick barrel, short strong legs and prominent bristle mane.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Deliberate power and stability.

**Avoid:** Not a miniature ordinary farm pig.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); racing selection.

**Visual build:** Longer legs, tighter waist, cleaner bristles and more balanced fore/hind proportions.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Disciplined pair racing, forceful starts.

**Avoid:** Keep boar head and split hooves.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); cold upland working line.

**Visual build:** Coarse winter coat, thick neck, compact stature, dark coloration.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Rugged mountain transport look.

**Avoid:** Not woolly like a sheep.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); show and ceremonial line.

**Visual build:** Rich reddish coat, dramatic shoulder bristle ridge and prominent tusk curve.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Highly recognizable silhouette.

**Avoid:** No invented armor or metal body growth.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); light racing line.

**Visual build:** Long fine legs, tucked waist, elegant head, close coat.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Agile quick-footed silhouette.

**Avoid:** Do not reduce to a fragile deer.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); agricultural multipurpose line.

**Visual build:** Deeper barrel, broader shoulders and sturdier hooves, retaining long legs.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Dependable and versatile.

**Avoid:** Still a Meadowstrider, not a horse.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); winding-course selection.

**Visual build:** Compact frame, low neck carriage, short back and responsive ears.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Tight maneuvering, alert movement.

**Avoid:** No antlers or fae glow.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); festival/show line.

**Visual build:** Pale honey coat, contrasting dorsal shading and particularly fine neck.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Graceful show silhouette.

**Avoid:** Coat is natural, not enchanted.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); mountain hauling line.

**Visual build:** Dense barrel, very thick neck, massive spiral horns, short sturdy limbs.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Monumental power.

**Avoid:** Horns must not intersect harness.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); lighter racing line.

**Visual build:** Lean body, shorter coat, long strong legs, moderate horn arc.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Athletic racing silhouette.

**Avoid:** Still unmistakably sheep-like.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); valley multipurpose line.

**Visual build:** Rounded fleece mass, sturdy frame, broad forehead and moderate horns.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Robust practical stock.

**Avoid:** Do not mistake wool bulk for muscle.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); showy aggressive-looking line.

**Visual build:** Red-brown horn tone, compact heavy chest, prominent curved horns.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Intense visual presence; temperament individual.

**Avoid:** Coloration does not imply aggression.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); heavy traditional line.

**Visual build:** Towering shoulder hump, immense mane, thick horns and heavy chest.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Raw monumental presence.

**Avoid:** No bison-only anatomy.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); open-country running line.

**Visual build:** Relatively leaner flank, longer legs, streamlined mane, strong hips.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Large fast runner.

**Avoid:** Do not shrink below species identity.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); dark-coated display line.

**Visual build:** Black-brown body, ash-gray mane, strongly curved horns.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Dramatic two-tone silhouette.

**Avoid:** No smoke or fire effects.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); temperament-selected working line.

**Visual build:** Broad body, moderate horn spread, steady posture and relaxed ear carriage.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Composed paired-harness appearance.

**Avoid:** Calmness is trained/selected, not guaranteed.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); powerful race line.

**Visual build:** Broad shoulders, deep chest, dark coat and dense neck ruff.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Intense predatory silhouette.

**Avoid:** No glowing eyes.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); open frontier endurance line.

**Visual build:** Longer legs, lighter frame, sandy gray coat, narrower head.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Lean distance-running presence.

**Avoid:** Not a domestic husky.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); cold-weather heavy coat line.

**Visual build:** Dense silver-gray coat, heavy tail, wide paws and thick chest.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Cold-country wolf look.

**Avoid:** Keep natural coat, no armor plating.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); distinctive facial marking line.

**Visual build:** Russet mask, dark dorsal stripe, compact powerful build.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Readable portrait markings.

**Avoid:** No infernal coloring or magic.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); heavy work line.

**Visual build:** Thick neck, broad chest, large plated scales, powerful thighs and thick tail.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Heavy draft silhouette.

**Avoid:** Scales not metal armor.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); lean racing line.

**Visual build:** Long legs, streamlined torso, smaller crest, narrow tail profile.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Fast and balanced.

**Avoid:** Must remain robust draconic quadruped.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); distinctive ornamental line.

**Visual build:** Tall cranial crest, pronounced dorsal ridge, contrasting belly scales.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Highly readable head silhouette.

**Avoid:** No wings or sails.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); hardy utility line.

**Visual build:** Dark green mottled scales, wide feet, strong forelegs and compact torso.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Practical sturdy drake.

**Avoid:** Not an amphibian by default.

**Reference / status:** Canon term for racing-bred Sunhorn.

**Visual build:** Lean powerful legs, streamlined body and controlled horn sweep.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Competitive racing presentation.

**Avoid:** No implied numerical speed bonus.

**Reference / status:** Canon term for heavy working Sunhorn.

**Visual build:** Broader chest, thicker neck, sturdier limbs and more substantial horns.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Heavy hauling identity.

**Avoid:** Not a different species.

**Reference / status:** Canon term for light endurance-oriented Sunhorn.

**Visual build:** Dry musculature, long legs, fine coat and narrow body profile.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Distance-running silhouette.

**Avoid:** Do not render skeletal.

**Reference / status:** Named catalog bloodline (v1.0); appearance-focused selection.

**Visual build:** Cream coat, strong dark facial mask and gently swept horns.

**Behavioral / motion impression:** Clear recognizable face pattern.

**Avoid:** Bloodline name is proposed, not preexisting canon.
